mcat_description.short: Portable Resort refers to factory-built or panel-assembled prefabricated structures designed for hospitality use — including resort rooms, cottages, glamping pods, and modular cabin units — that can be rapidly deployed and dismantled at tourism or leisure sites.
mcat_description.long: Portable Resorts are prefabricated modular structures purpose-built for the hospitality and eco-tourism sector, constructed using materials such as steel sandwich panels, FRP (fibre-reinforced plastic), treated timber, bamboo composites, or cement panels, and assembled on-site with minimal civil work. These structures serve as fully functional resort rooms or cottages with integrated bedroom, bathroom, and living spaces, and can be customised in size, layout, and finish to match the aesthetic requirements of the deployment site. A key advantage in the Indian market is their classification as temporary/dismantlable structures, which makes them eligible for deployment in Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) areas where permanent construction is restricted. Buyers range from boutique resort developers and eco-tourism entrepreneurs to hotel chains seeking rapid capacity expansion in remote or difficult-terrain locations.

market_context: In the Indian market, 'Portable Resort' is an established B2B product category referring to prefabricated hospitality structures deployed by resort developers, eco-tourism operators, and hotel chains seeking rapid, cost-effective accommodation expansion. Key materials used include steel (MS/GI), FRP, treated timber, bamboo composites, and cement/Aerocon panels — with steel panel-build and FRP being the most commercially dominant. A significant market driver unique to India is CRZ (Coastal Regulation Zone) compliance: prefabricated resort structures are classified as temporary/dismantlable structures, enabling legal deployment on coastal and ecologically sensitive sites where permanent construction is prohibited. Relevant BIS standards for prefabricated construction include IS 15916:2011 (prefabricated concrete systems) and IS 15917:2010 (mixed/composite construction), though no single mandatory BIS standard governs the full portable resort product category. Manufacturers are concentrated in Delhi-NCR, Maharashtra (Mumbai, Pune), Odisha (Bhubaneswar), and Gujarat (Ahmedabad), with pan-India delivery and on-site assembly. The category overlaps with Portable Cabin and Container Homes in taxonomy but is distinguished by its explicit hospitality/resort end-use framing and aesthetic customisation requirements. Pricing is typically quoted per sq ft for custom builds or per unit for standard cabin sizes (single source — low confidence for specific price bands).
